title: Only the first rideable tame can ever be ridden: later mounts (and their saddles) are unreachable
steps: Open /game/games/isles/index.html?test=1&isle=reef with a stable that has a Tusktop (t1) and a Tidesteed (t4), saddle_tidesteed in the pack, tames.mount null
Press R (or tap Ride)
Toast says 'Riding tusktop'; the Tidesteed is never offered. Same with a Stegolith after a Tusktop on the jungle: crafting saddle_stegolith changes nothing
expected: A way to pick which tame is the mount (Party/stable tab), or the mount follows the island (swim mount on the reef, flier on mars)
actual: refreshMount() always picks tames.mount, else the first rideable tame in the roster. TAMES.setMount is only called when the mount is empty at tame time (adoptTame) and from mountUp for the already chosen mount. 9 of the 10 saddle recipes (and 11 of 12 mount abilities) are dead content for anyone who tamed a Tusktop (or any mount) first; on the reef the hero rides a land Tusktop

title: Party is fixed to the first two tames; no UI to swap, release or view the stable
steps: Seed or play until 4 tames exist (2 in party)
Pack > Party tab
expected: A list of the whole stable with party / mount / rest toggles (the Log even says 'in your stable N')
actual: The Party tab lists only the 2 party members as plain text 'name (mode)' and 'Stable 4. XP 0.' Tames 3+ never join the party; there is no release/rename/swap anywhere (setParty is only called from adoptTame). The home Tame pen shows resting tames, but the party can never change

title: Party companions in attack mode (the default for any dps>0 tame) shred the creature you are soothing to tame
steps: Seed party [fernraptor, tusktop] (both start in 'attack')
Spawn a stegolith 4 tiles away, Soothe on, fire soothe shots at it until KO (37 shots)
Repeat with party set to follow / stay (command button C)
expected: Soothe shots knock it out; companions leave a tame target alone (or the hint tells you to set Stay)
actual: attack mode: stegolith HP fell 153 -> 1 (KO'd with 1 HP; one stray hit would kill it); follow/stay: HP 140, KO with the party untouched. In a second party-attack run a Fern Raptor target vanished before KO. The command button does not mention it and nothing warns a new player that their pets kill the tame
suspect: game/shared/mm-companion.js target choice; game/games/isles/isles.js compCtx.enemies = creatures

title: Reloading the page resets every glint (92/93 ready) and the taming pouch: free infinite gathering/feeding
steps: Fresh save, ?test=1, walk over every glint (93 picked, wood 35, berries 39)
Reload the page
expected: Glint respawn timers (180-900 s) survive a reload, or at least the pouch is not a free refill
actual: After reload 92 of 93 nodes are ready again; inventory kept, so reload = a full second harvest in seconds. Nodes use wall clock (n.until <= clock.now()) and are never saved. The pouch is rebuilt per visit by design (IF1) so food is also free per reload. This trivialises every respawn and the 12-golden-apple Oakback (b05-05)

title: Oakback (rare XL) needs 12 golden apples but the whole island has 1 golden-apple glint (900 s respawn)
steps: ?isle=home&test=1; list CR.get('oakback').tame and I.foodGlints()/nodes()
expected: A reachable food supply for the tame (same as other rares)
actual: oakback: need 12, feedEvery 14 s (about 3 min of chewing), diet golden_apple only. Sources: 1 glint (respawn 900 s, zone 2-3 only), a small bonus forage chance, nothing in the Hearth Isle pouch (clover 10, apple 4). Practically hours of waiting, or reload farming (b05-04). Compare meadow_strider (10 x golden_apple/apple, 6 apple glints + 4 pouch apples: fine). Same pattern: isleback_turtle needs 12 sea_melon from 3 glints (240 s respawn), void_grazer 12 meteor_glass

title: Craft has no duplicate guard: a double tap makes two saddles/keepsakes and burns the materials
steps: Give hide 9, vine_rope 9, wood 9
Open Craft while riding, double-click Stegolith saddle
expected: A saddle (kept, never used up), rocket core, raft or trophy only needs one: button disabled / 'have 1' warning
actual: Two stegolith saddles crafted (hide 9 -> 3), the second is wasted. Craft while riding is allowed and fine. Triple-tap on Feast crafted exactly 2 (all 6 meat), 3rd refused cleanly (no negative counts, no errors). Craft with 0, unknown/__proto__/null ids, give(-5/NaN/Infinity/'3') all refuse or clamp (999 per stack, 64 stacks, 'full' toast)

title: Gathering with a full pack may spend the spot and lose the item (code read, not reproduced in play)
steps: Fill 64 distinct stacks (API give) and gather a new kind
expected: Nothing is consumed and a pack-full toast shows
actual: gatherNear(): HS.gather() marks the spot taken for the day, then invAdd() may return 0 (stack cap 999 / 64 stacks) while the toast still says 'You found X'. I could not find a free new-kind node after 64 stacks so this is code-only. Craft already reports 'full' correctly

title: Feed feedback lags/contradicts: stale 'Normal shots.' toast and a toast timer behind the button
steps: Phone, KO a Fern Raptor, toggle Soothe off, tap Feed once a second
actual: First Feed tap shows the old 'Normal shots.' toast (from the Soothe toggle). Early taps toast 'ready in 6 s' while the button reads 'Chewing 5s', staying one tick behind. Soothe button label stays 'Soothe' on or off (only icon + aria-pressed change). Pacing itself is fine: 6 feeds x ~7 s = about 45 s for a Fern Raptor with 67 s of torpor left at KO

title: Log tab empty-state text has a gap: 'Nothing gathered yet. Look   for sparkles.'
steps: Fresh save, Pack > Log
expected: Continuous sentence (or an icon where the gap is)
actual: A wide blank (probably a missing inline icon) in the Collection line

title: First-visit how-to card sits over the hero (desktop) and a toast stacks on top of it (phone); phone HUD truncates hero/island name
steps: Fresh save at 1280x720: find the hero
390x844: ride a mount in the first 9 s
Read the phone HUD name column
expected: Hero visible, toast and card not overlapping, names readable
actual: Desktop: the 320 px card covers the hero at screen centre. Phone: 'Riding tuskto. R to get off.' toast lies on the card text. HUD names are ellipsised ('Wanderer - ...', 'Verdant Jungle...')
